mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the most recent month indicates an easing monetary policy, which reduces the discount rate for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when FEDFUNDS declines by more than 0.25pp over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals labor market weakness, which indicates economic slowdown and reduced corporate profits, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when UNRATE rises by more than 0.2pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates broad-based demand weakness, which signals economic contraction and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline > 0.5% in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline by more than 0.5% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: In a supply-constrained regime, a decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals worsening supply conditions, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when INDPRO declines and the economy is in a supply-constrained regime.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in nonfarm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when PAYEMS increases by more than 50,000 jobs in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past three months signals heightened inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which depresses S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and persistent high federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) indicates a tightening monetary policy cycle with labor market weakness, signaling an impending economic slowdown and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises > 0.3pp and FEDFUNDS > 4.5% in 3 months
regime_hint: monetary tightening with labor market stress
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) in periods when UNRATE rises by more than 0.3pp and FEDFUNDS is above 4.5% for at least 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: In the early stages of an economic expansion, a rise in housing starts (HOUST) signals strengthening consumer demand and business investment, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) in periods when HOUST rises by more than 1% in the prior month during early-cycle expansion.
